provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Sets a noun up as the yardstick a comment is scaled to, with mild surprise at how the subject comes out against it: チワワにしちゃよく食べる. Class sibling としちゃ sets the same yardstick flatly (国産としちゃ高い). The same string is filed in the 逆接-想外 class when the standard is a clause and the mismatch itself is the news (一日で仕上げたにしては上出来だ). にしちゃ is the clipped spoken realization of にしては and rare in formal writing.

examples.ruby: この値段[ねだん]にしちゃ、味[あじ]はなかなかのものだ。
examples.english: For what it costs, the taste is honestly pretty good.

examples.ruby: うちの犬[いぬ]はチワワにしちゃ、よく食[た]べるほうだ。
examples.english: For a chihuahua, ours puts away a fair amount of food.

examples.ruby: 三月[さんがつ]にしちゃ、ずいぶん風[かぜ]が冷[つめ]たいね。
examples.english: Pretty biting wind for March, isn't it.

patterns.usage_note: Names the class the subject is measured in, so the judgment that follows is relative to that class rather than to things in general: 国産としちゃ高い prices a watch against domestic watches. The sibling lane of the same string names the capacity or standpoint an opinion is spoken from (俺としちゃ賛成だ), where the noun holds the view instead of naming a category. としちゃ is casual; としては is the neutral written form.

examples.ruby: この時計[とけい]は国産[こくさん]としちゃ、かなり値段[ねだん]が張[は]るな。
examples.english: As domestic watches go, this one carries a pretty steep price.

examples.ruby: ここは都心[としん]のワンルームとしちゃ広[ひろ]いほうだ。
examples.english: For a downtown studio apartment, this place is on the roomy side.

examples.ruby: 妹[いもうと]の絵[え]は子供[こども]としちゃ、色[いろ]の使[つか]い方[かた]がうまい。
examples.english: For a kid, my little sister uses color awfully well in that picture.
